svg.title: EP2 C1 AREA 06
svg.desc: Temple is switch-heavy. Follow the numbered rooms and mechanism markers, and regroup only after each split is complete. Watch the stomping pillars. Before the boss, sort out recovery items and Scape Dolls, and grind the best Dagger with Hit or A.Beast. Room 2's traps detonate slowly and can be ignored. One player holds the button to open west warp A; once the solo player takes it, east warp B opens. Everyone else warps through B together so they can walk past the Dark Belra in the hallway. The solo player (3a) presses the switch farther from the warp point, then the nearer one in the hallway; the others (3c) press the farther one at the first pair and the nearer one at the second. After looting the boxes north of 3b, the solo player heads south and both groups meet in room 4. Room 5: one player holds the button while the rest warp C→C′. The button at the south end of the C′ room drops the bridge barrier and spawns 2 Foie traps and the first wave: an Android should stand on it, set a Freeze Trap at once and stay until everyone has crossed. The hallway toward room 6 has a stomper dealing 100 fixed damage, enough to kill some classes at full HP. Room 7: break the third barrier from the door and warp D→D′ at the south wall. In room 8, clear the Poison Lilies, take the outer walkway around the stompers and warp E→E′ to the north.
